explanation_of_previous_equality: In R1.1, the builder script mechanically called addAtomicFact which iterated atomicFacts and pushed exactly one relation for every fact (including descriptive HAS_PROPERTY facts and incomplete headers). In R1.2, true ontological separation is established: 120 descriptive facts emit 0 graph relations, 85 facts emit 1 relation, and 3 multi-entity junction facts emit 6 relations.
